pack.title: Parties weddings
pack.description: Decline alcohol without explaining private reasons.

scenarios.setting: At a wedding, a guest pressures you to drink after you decline.
scenarios.jab: Don't be boring; have a proper drink with us.
scenarios.goal: Decline alcohol without explaining private reasons.

replies.line: I'm happy with this. Enjoy yours.
replies.why: It affirms your choice without making anyone else's choice the problem.
replies.delivery: Keep your drink in hand, speak steadily, and avoid negotiating a quantity.

replies.why: It gives a complete refusal without a reason to challenge.
replies.delivery: Keep your drink in hand, speak steadily, and avoid negotiating a quantity.

replies.line: I'm enjoying the evening with this drink; let's toast anyway.
replies.why: It preserves participation in the celebration while declining alcohol.
replies.delivery: Keep your drink in hand, speak steadily, and avoid negotiating a quantity.

replies.line: My dance moves don't need extra fuel.
replies.why: Self-directed humor keeps the celebration warm without reopening the drink decision.
replies.delivery: Keep your drink in hand, speak steadily, and avoid negotiating a quantity.

followUp.line: I'm not having one; please stop asking.
followUp.why: It moves from a polite refusal to an explicit boundary after continued pressure.
followUp.delivery: Keep your drink in hand, speak steadily, and avoid negotiating a quantity.
